Dear All,Effective May 4th, 2026, the “General Payment” option will be removed from the self-service portal. All general payment requests must be submitted through the new Payment Request flow in the Back-Office Operations system.You can access it via the Apps section on the self-service portal or using this link and CRM credentials.


Please refer to the attached help document for further details on usage. For support, contact the Accounting or Procurement team.​Best Regards,Ali Al TawilBusiness ManagerM: +971529708536Visit: www.famproperties.comGrab a copyThe Art of Real Estate InvestmentEmpowering Smarter DecisionsStay connected Stay ahead of the property market.
